4:   "full_target": "The complete Theorem 1 (Logarithm-free convergence), with its Section 2 standing definitions and fixed scheme, on PDF page 2.\n\nUse the periodic domain mathbbT = reals/(2*pi*integers) with normalized measure dx/(2*pi). For a periodic function f, hat f(k) = (2*pi)^(-1) integral_0^(2*pi) f(x) exp(-i*k*x) dx and <k> = (1+k^2)^(1/2). The Sobolev norm is ||f||_(H^s)^2 = sum_(k in Z) <k>^(2*s) |hat f(k)|^2. These spaces are completions of trigonometric polynomials in these norms, with negative-order spaces interpreted as distributions. Reality means hat f(-k) = conjugate(hat f(k)); mean zero means hat f(0) = 0. Time suprema use continuous representatives; derivative norms use essential suprema.\n\nLet S_t = exp(-t*partial_x^3), with Fourier multiplier exp(i*t*k^3). Let P0 be the spatial mean and P = I-P0. Let D^(-1) = partial_x^(-1) have multiplier (i*k)^(-1) for k != 0 and zero at k=0, and D^(-2) = (D^(-1))^2. The equation is\n  u_t + u_xxx = (1/2)*partial_x(u^2), u(0)=u0.\nThe exact solution is the unique real mean-zero C([0,T];H^gamma) distributional solution obtained by smooth approximation.\n\nFor timestep tau=T/L, the time-semidiscrete scheme is exactly\n  u^0 = u0,\n  u^(n+1) = S_tau u^n + F_tau(u^n) + H_tau(u^n),\nwhere all products below are spatial products and [G(s)]_(s=0)^(s=tau) means G(tau)-G(0):\n  F_tau(f) = (1/6)*P[(S_tau D^(-1) f)^2]\n             - (1/6)*S_tau P[(D^(-1) f)^2],\n  H_tau(f) = (1/3)*P[(S_tau D^(-1) f)*D^(-1) F_tau(f)]\n             + (tau/9)*(S_tau D^(-1) f)*P0(f^2)\n             - (1/54)*[S_(tau-s) D^(-1)[(S_s D^(-1) f)^3]]_(s=0)^(s=tau)\n             - (1/(27*tau))*[S_(tau-s) D^(-2)[(S_(s-tau) D^(-2) F_tau(f))*(S_s D^(-1) f)]]_(s=0)^(s=tau).\nThis is the source scheme (2), with no spatial frequency cutoff.\n\nFor every T>0, 0<gamma<=1 and R>0, there exist C>0 and tau0>0 depending only on T,gamma,R such that, for every real mean-zero u0 in H^gamma(mathbbT) with ||u0||_(H^gamma)<=R and every positive integer L with tau=T/L<=tau0, this fixed scheme satisfies\n  max_(0<=n<=L) ||u(n*tau)-u^n||_(L^2) <= C*tau^gamma.\nThe constants are uniform over the entire stated initial-data ball and all permitted timesteps, with no Fourier-support restriction. The target includes all the hypotheses, quantifiers, endpoints, solution convention and method above.",

4:     {
5:       "id": "S001",
6:       "text": "Fix a real mean-zero q in H^gamma and assume L1: ||q||_(H^gamma)<=R. H001-H003 give T>0, 0<gamma<=1 and R>0. Use E001 for source datum U0(x)=-q(-x), exponent s=gamma and horizon T. Reflection and sign preserve the Fourier Sobolev and L2 norms, so ||U0||_(dot H^gamma)<=R and ||U0||_2<=R. The source yields a global unique continuous flow, its uniform Sobolev bound, and smooth flows when the datum is smooth (apply its positive regularity statements for each integer exponent in that case). Its Galerkin bound and limiting-solution bound are uniform for the prescribed norm bounds."
7:     },
8:     {
9:       "id": "S002",
10:       "text": "Take that source flow U and set u(t,x)=-U(t,-x). At (t,-x), u_t=-U_t, u_x=U_x and u_xxx=U_xxx, so u_t+u_xxx=-U U_x=u*u_x. Fourier coefficients are hat u(k)=-hat U(-k), preserving reality, zero mean and every Fourier norm. On mean-zero functions and s>=0, |k|<=<k><=sqrt(2)|k|, hence ||f||_(dot H^s)<=||f||_(H^s)<=2^(s/2)||f||_(dot H^s); for s<0 the inequalities reverse as in the supplied norm convention. The source bound therefore gives some A(T,gamma,R) in our norm. It also holds for a smooth-approximation limit by passing first in each finite Fourier norm sum and then taking the supremum over finite sets. The sign-reflection map is invertible, so uniqueness and continuous dependence transfer. Finally differentiation of v=S_(-t)u cancels the linear KdV term and yields v'=B_t(v,v)/2 for smooth data; the unimodular Fourier symbol of S preserves all norms. Thus M=1+sup||v||_(H^gamma)<=1+A as asserted. This proves the asserted existence, bound, twist identity and solution convention for arbitrary q under L1; discharge L1."
11:     },
12:     {
13:       "id": "S003",
14:       "text": "For arbitrary real mean-zero L2 data q1,q2 and B0>=0, temporarily assume L2: ||q1||_2+||q2||_2<=B0. Apply E001's theta=0 dependence statement at time horizon T to -q1(-x),-q2(-x). Their norms and their difference norm are unchanged. The source twists are unitary, so its dependence bound gives sup_[0,T]||u_q1-u_q2||_2<=C(T,B0)||q1-q2||_2 in physical variables after sign-reflection. Discharge L2."
15:     },
16:     {
17:       "id": "S004",
18:       "text": "Fix tau>0 and real alpha,beta. If either phase is zero, substitution in eta shows exact cancellation. Otherwise put h(s)=exp(-i*alpha*s)-M_tau(exp(-i*alpha*s)). The covariance is tau^(-1)integral_0^tau h(s)exp(-i*beta*s)ds. By the fundamental theorem of calculus, |exp(-i*alpha*s)-exp(-i*alpha*r)|<=|alpha||s-r|. Averaging in r gives |h(s)|<=tau|alpha|, and consequently |eta|<=tau|alpha|. Interchange alpha,beta to obtain the minimum. Also |h(0)|+|h(tau)|<=tau|alpha| and integral_0^tau|h'(s)|ds=tau|alpha|. Integrating the beta exponential once by parts gives |eta|<=(|h(0)|+|h(tau)|+integral|h'|)/(tau|beta|)<=2|alpha/beta|. Interchanging phases proves the other ratio. These arguments apply to smooth scalar exponentials, so the calculus identities have no limiting issue."
19:     },
20:     {
21:       "id": "S005",
22:       "text": "Fix nonzero integer frequencies a,b,c,d with sum zero, order their magnitudes N1>=N2>=N3>=N4, and put A=|ab|, B0=|cd|. Triangle inequality gives N1<=3N2. For the first majorant, if d is among the largest two, min(A/B0,B0/A)<=1 and 1/|d|<=1/N3. Otherwise the two largest are among a,b,c. If they are a,b, use (B0/A)/|d|=|c|/|ab|<=1/N3. If they are a,c, their ratio lies in [1/3,3], giving (1/|d|)min(A/B0,B0/A)<=3 min(|b|/|d|^2,1/|b|)<=3/max(|b|,|d|)=3/N3; the last inequality follows by dividing into |b|<=|d| and its complement. The b,c case is the identical exchange of a,b. For the second majorant, if the largest two lie in a single pair (a,b) or (c,d), the other pair sum has magnitude <=2N3, whereas max(A,B0)>=N1N2>=N3^2. Since a+b=-(c+d), the ratio is <=2/N3. If they lie in different pairs, the third largest is paired with one of them, so max(A,B0)>=N2N3 while |a+b|<=2N1<=6N2. This gives 6/N3. Ties admit any ordering and the cases still exhaust all possibilities."
23:     },
24:     {
25:       "id": "S006",
26:       "text": "Fix four finitely supported nonnegative sequences x1,x2,x3,x4 on Z\\{0}. Decompose each into shells 2^j<=|k|<2^(j+1), j>=0, and let X_(r,j) be its ell2 norm on shell j. Fix one ordering of shell indices j1>=j2>=j3>=j4 (and correspondingly permute the input labels). Any zero-sum interaction has j1-j2<=2: the largest magnitude is at most three times the second largest, while a gap >=3 would give a ratio greater than four. For each fixed pair of the smaller frequencies, the sum over the two larger frequencies is bounded by the product of their ell2 norms, since one is a translated reflection of the other. Each small shell contains 2^(j+1) integers. Cauchy-Schwarz on the smaller shells therefore bounds the unweighted four-frequency sum by C*2^((j3+j4)/2)*product_r X_(r,jr). Division by N3>=2^j3 leaves C*2^(-(j3-j4)/2)."
27:     },
28:     {
29:       "id": "S007",
30:       "text": "Sum F001 with the offset q=j1-j2 in {0,1,2}. Dropping the upper restriction on the small shell indices only increases this positive sum, leaving at most C*(sum_J X_(1,J)X_(2,J-q))*(sum_(ell>=m)2^(-(ell-m)/2)X_(3,ell)X_(4,m)). Interpret negative shell subscripts as zero. Cauchy-Schwarz bounds the first factor by ||X_1||_ell2||X_2||_ell2. In the second set r=ell-m, apply Cauchy-Schwarz to each shifted scalar product, and sum the geometric series: its bound is ||X_3||_ell2||X_4||_ell2/(1-2^(-1/2)). Sum over at most 24 shell orderings and three offsets. Since sum_j X_(r,j)^2=||x_r||_ell2^2, this proves the finite estimate. For arbitrary nonnegative square-summable inputs, restrict all four to |k|<=m. The positive sum is the increasing supremum of these finite sums and the restricted norms are bounded by the original norms; taking the supremum proves the infinite estimate. Restricting the positive summation set can only decrease it."
31:     },
32:     {

The phase ratios are A/B0 and B0/A. N002 yields |eta|/|k|<=6/N3. Its small-time bound also gives |eta|/(tau|abck|)<=3|p|*min(A,B0)/(A B0)=3|p|/max(A,B0)<=18/N3. Their norms are at most the H^s input norms and one. The prefactor tau/18 gives the asserted tau^(1+s) bound. The time phase and any inserted multiplier of modulus <=1 cannot increase this majorant. Trilinearity and the estimate make polynomial approximations Cauchy in L2 and make the limit independent of approximating sequences; this gives the unique bounded trilinear extension."

42:       "text": "Now H002 gives 0<gamma<=1. Fix mean-zero w in H^gamma and f in L2, and temporarily assume L1: ||w||_(H^gamma)<=M, delta=||f-w||_2<=1 and 0<tau<=1. F002 with sigma=gamma controls R2(w,w,w) by C M^3 tau^(1+gamma). Telescope R2(f,f,f)-R2(w,w,w) into three trilinear terms with one slot f-w and other slots chosen from f,w. F002 with sigma=0 controls their sum by C tau delta (||f||_2+||w||_2)^2. Since ||f||_2<=M+1, this is at most C_M tau delta, proving the numerical-state estimate. The argument introduces no Sobolev regularity for f. Discharge L1 into the numerical-state bound's antecedent."
43:     },
44:     {
45:       "id": "S011",
46:       "text": "Orthogonality of exp(i*k*x) in normalized measure gives the L2 Fourier norm identity on polynomials; completion gives it on L2. Unimodularity and conjugate symmetry of exp(i*t*k^3) give unitarity, reality and mean preservation of S directly in Fourier coefficients. Cauchy-Schwarz gives ||Dinv f||_infty<=(sum_(k!=0)k^(-2))^(1/2)||f||_2, and ||Dinv f||_(H^1)<=sqrt(2)||f||_2. More generally H^1 embeds in L^infty by the same summable reciprocal weights. For A0,B0 in H^1, the product rule together with this embedding gives ||A0 B0||_(H^1)<=C||A0||_(H^1)||B0||_(H^1), first on polynomials and then by density. Apply this to the two inverse derivatives to obtain the J bound. The Fourier coefficient of a product of two L2 functions is bounded by the product of their L2 norms by Cauchy-Schwarz. Therefore ||B_t(f,g)||_(H^(-p_star))^2<=||f||_2^2||g||_2^2 sum_(k!=0) k^2<k>^(-2*p_star), and this series converges because p_star=23/14>3/2. The same coefficient bound with sum k^(-2) gives ||Dinv P(FG)||_2<=C||F||_2||G||_2. On mean-zero coefficients <k>^(-p_star)<=|k|^(-1), so the negative-norm comparison follows. In J_t(A0,B0), bound its first inverse derivative in L2 and its second in L^infty to get the asymmetric bound. All constants are uniform in t since S is an isometry. Bounded-product extensions follow by the displayed estimates and density."
47:     },
48:     {
49:       "id": "S012",
50:       "text": "For smooth mean-zero paths f,g the nonzero kth Fourier coefficient of J_t(f,g) is sum_(a+b=k) exp(-i*3*k*a*b*t)(i*a)^(-1)(i*b)^(-1) hat f(a)hat g(b). Differentiating the phase contributes 3*i*k times the product coefficient. Thus partial_t J_t(f,g)=3 B_t(f,g)+J_t(f',g)+J_t(f,g'). Integrate in time and divide by three to obtain the normal-form identity with both endpoints. Smooth spatial Fourier series and their derivatives converge absolutely, justifying the differentiation. J is symmetric. In J_t(B_t(f,g),h), Dinv B_t(f,g)=S_(-t)P[(S_t f)(S_t g)], since Dinv*partial_x=P. Substitution, without commuting any operator through a product, gives the stated Cint identity after integration. The calculation holds on each smooth time piece, so summing preserves both external endpoints. For time-independent f set g=f and divide the integral by two; this yields Stage(t;f)=[J_s(f,f)]/6."
51:     },

53:       "id": "S013",
54:       "text": "Apply E002 with alpha=0 to arbitrary X paths on I=[a,b], 0<=a<=b, |I|<=1. This is exactly its L^infty L2 and derivative H^(-23/14) hypothesis, and any slot may carry the negative norm. For constant H^s inputs apply its time-independent clause with alpha=s in [0,1]. The source operator C is exactly Cint: e^(t partial_x^3)=S_(-t) and Fourier coefficients, projections and inverse derivatives agree. Every source L2 and H^r norm, and hence X norm, equals sqrt(2*pi) times ours. Dividing the trilinear inequalities by sqrt(2*pi) changes only their constants by 2*pi. Thus both normalized inequalities follow, also for continuous piecewise smooth paths with their weak derivatives."

61:       "id": "S015",
62:       "text": "Choose once and for all 0<epsilon_stage<=1/8 sufficiently small for E004 at sigma=1/2. This choice follows from E004's 'any fixed sufficiently small epsilon>0': the allowed positive epsilons include an interval immediately to the right of zero, which contains a number at most 1/8. Fix this choice independently of the state, norm bound, timestep, step index and spectral support. This auxiliary choice leaves a_gamma=1/8 at gamma=1/2 unchanged. Fix mean-zero w in H^gamma with ||w||_(H^gamma)<=M, 0<tau<=1 and n>=0. Apply E004 with f=g=w, sigma=gamma, beta=a_gamma, and epsilon=epsilon_stage in the midpoint case, uniformly over all times in the step. If 0<gamma<1/2, beta0=2*gamma-3/2, a_gamma-beta0=2-3*gamma>0 and 1+gamma-a_gamma=1/2+2*gamma>0. Its time exponent is (1/2+2*gamma)/(5/2-gamma); subtracting gamma gives (gamma^2-gamma/2+1/2)/(5/2-gamma)>0, since the numerator equals (gamma-1/4)^2+7/16. If gamma=1/2, beta0=-1/2-epsilon_stage<1/8=a_gamma<3/2=1+gamma. The time exponent is (11/8)/(2+epsilon_stage)=11/(16+8*epsilon_stage)>=11/17>1/2=gamma. If 1/2<gamma<=1, beta0=gamma-1<=0=a_gamma<=1+gamma, and the time exponent (1+gamma)/2 is at least gamma. All denominators are positive. Thus in every case the allowed beta yields a power at least gamma. Because 0<tau<=1, replacing that power by gamma enlarges the right side, proving sup_step||Stage(t;w)||_(H^a_gamma)<=C_gamma*M^2*tau^gamma after converting norms. Next apply E004 with the same inputs and beta=1+gamma, retaining epsilon=epsilon_stage at the midpoint. This beta is the included upper endpoint; the denominator is respectively 5/2-gamma, 2+epsilon_stage, or 2, and the numerator is zero. Hence sup_step||Stage(t;w)||_(H^(1+gamma))<=C_gamma*M^2. For either application, dividing the source output norm by sqrt(2*pi) and replacing the two source input norms by sqrt(2*pi) times their normalized norms only changes the constant by sqrt(2*pi). The fixed admissible midpoint choice is absorbed into C_gamma. Both constants therefore have the asserted C_(M,gamma) form and are independent of the step, interval position and spectral support. 1: Removing the logarithmic loss in the Li–Wu KdV integrator
2: Kaiwen Jin
3: yui.ui.siki@gmail.com
4: 10 October 2026
5: Abstract
6: Li and Wu proved that their unfiltered integrator for periodic KdV converges inL2 with
7: error O(τγ log(1/τ))for real, mean-zero Hγ data,0 <γ≤ 1. We remove the logarithmic factor
8: for the same time-semidiscrete algorithm, with constants uniform on boundedHγ sets. The
9: main estimate concerns the exact averaged cubic remainder. Retaining both ratios of its two
10: oscillatory phases bounds the dual four-frequency multiplier by the reciprocal of the third largest
11: frequency. A dyadic four-linear estimate sums this majorant without a logarithm and includes
12: a mixedL2 endpoint. That endpoint controls the remainder at the numerical state without a
13: numerical Sobolev bound. We then prove the full global estimate using the continuous trilinear
14: bounds of Li and Wu, a stepwise residual calculation, low–high frequency stability, a restarted
15: bootstrap, and density. Finite Fourier experiments check the implemented update, the remainder,
16: and accumulated step defects.
17: 1 Introduction
18: Low spatial regularity limits the accuracy of time discretizations for dispersive equations. For
19: periodic KdV, differentiation in the quadratic nonlinearity makes a directL2 perturbation estimate
20: insufficient. The unfiltered method of Li and Wu integrates the leading oscillatory interactions
21: explicitly and treats its numerical trajectory as a perturbed KdV solution. Their convergence
22: theorem givesCτγ log(1/τ)in L2 forHγ data with0 <γ≤ 1[ 1, Theorem 1.1]. The necessity of the
23: logarithm is left open in [1, Section 11]; this is the fixed-scheme question in AIM problem 518 [3].
24: We prove the boundCτγ for that same method, uniformly on bounded sets of real, mean-zero
25: Hγ data. The improvement comes from the averaging remainder, rather than a change in the update.
26: Its multiplier contains the covariance of two exponential phases. Each phase can be integrated
27: against the other, giving two ratio bounds. Keeping their minimum matters when the output
28: frequency is small. After duality the four frequencies sum to zero, their largest two magnitudes
29: are comparable, and the remaining multiplier is controlled by1/N3, whereN3 is the third largest
30: magnitude. The smaller dyadic scales then carry a summable geometric factor.
31: The resulting trilinear estimate includes exponent zero. This is a local remainder estimate: it
32: does not assert a uniform global rate on anL2 ball. Its role is to compare the cubic remainder at the
33: numerical state with the remainder at an exactHγ state using only theirL2 difference. We retain
34: the continuous trilinear estimates of Li and Wu and give the residual and stability argument in full.
35: In particular, the normal-form identity keeps both endpoints when the time interval is restarted,
36: and its forcing term is estimated from the actual stepwise residual. A fixed-timestep approximation
37: argument then removes the temporary smoothness used in the calculations.
38: The experiments use a fixed finite Fourier cutoff, complete polynomial intermediates, and
39: independently checked reference resolutions. They illustrate the remainder and error accumulation.

97:       "id": "S024",
98:       "text": "Fix any smooth real mean-zero solution u of u_t+u_xxx=(1/2)*partial_x(u^2) on [0,T], the normalized KdV equation of D020, and define v(t)=S_(-t)u(t). Take its numerical interpolation V with residual Rres. Put M=1+sup||v||_(H^gamma), e=v-V and fix I=[a,b] starting at a grid point, h=b-a<=1, 0<tau<=1. Assume L1: E_I=sup_I||e||_2<=1. At each step intersecting I use f=v^n=V(t_n), w=v(t_n), delta_n=||f-w||_2<=E_I and q_n=tau^gamma+delta_n. N007 supplies the actual residual identity and grid values, and N009 gives sup||rho_n||_2<=C_M tau q_n and ||Rres'||_(L^infty H^(-p_star))<=C_M q_n. There are at most h/tau+1 intersected steps (including a final partial step). Hence sup_(a<=t<=b)||Rres(t)-Rres(a)||_2<=C_M(h+tau)(tau^gamma+E_I). For the exact path, D004 gives partial_t S_(-t)=partial_x^3 S_(-t), commuting with spatial derivatives. Thus v'=S_(-t)(u_t+u_xxx)=(1/2)S_(-t)partial_x(u^2)=(1/2)B_t(v,v), since S_t v=u. Smoothness justifies this differentiation and the spatial products. Subtracting N007's identity V'=B_t(V,V)/2+Rres' and using symmetry and bilinearity gives e'=(B_t(v,v)-B_t(V,V))/2-Rres'=B_t(e,(v+V)/2)-Rres'=B_t(e,v-e/2)-Rres'. N005 then gives ||e||_X(I)<=C_M(tau^gamma+E_I), and ||v||_X(I)+||V||_X(I)<=C_M. Here V=v-e, and the exact solution has L2 norm <=M throughout."

47: ## Implementation
48: 
49: Since `lp` is defined as an `AddSubgroup`, dot notation does not work. Use `lp.norm_neg f` to
50: say that `‖-f‖ = ‖f‖`, instead of the non-working `f.norm_neg`.

55:   rings which has `‖∑' i, f i * g i‖` rather than `∑' i, ‖f i‖ * g i‖` on the RHS; a version for
56:   three exponents satisfying `1 / r = 1 / p + 1 / q`)
57:

68: /-!
69: ### `Memℓp` predicate
70: 
71: -/
72: 
73: 
74: /-- The property that `f : ∀ i : α, E i`
75: * is finitely supported, if `p = 0`, or
76: * admits an upper bound for `Set.range (fun i ↦ ‖f i‖)`, if `p = ∞`, or
77: * has the series `∑' i, ‖f i‖ ^ p` be summable, if `0 < p < ∞`. -/
78: def Memℓp (f : ∀ i, E i) (p : ℝ≥0∞) : Prop :=
79:   if p = 0 then Set.Finite { i | f i ≠ 0 }
80:   else if p = ∞ then BddAbove (Set.range fun i => ‖f i‖)
81:   else Summable fun i => ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal
82: 
83: theorem memℓp_zero_iff {f : ∀ i, E i} : Memℓp f 0 ↔ Set.Finite { i | f i ≠ 0 } := by
84:   dsimp [Memℓp]
85:   rw [if_pos rfl]
86: 
87: theorem memℓp_zero {f : ∀ i, E i} (hf : Set.Finite { i | f i ≠ 0 }) : Memℓp f 0 :=
88:   memℓp_zero_iff.2 hf
89: 
90: theorem memℓp_infty_iff {f : ∀ i, E i} : Memℓp f ∞ ↔ BddAbove (Set.range fun i => ‖f i‖) := by
91:   simp [Memℓp]
92: 
93: theorem memℓp_infty {f : ∀ i, E i} (hf : BddAbove (Set.range fun i => ‖f i‖)) : Memℓp f ∞ :=
94:   memℓp_infty_iff.2 hf
95: 
96: theorem memℓp_gen_iff (hp : 0 < p.toReal) {f : ∀ i, E i} :
97:     Memℓp f p ↔ Summable fun i => ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal := by
98:   rw [ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff] at hp
99:   dsimp [Memℓp]
100:   rw [if_neg hp.1.ne', if_neg hp.2.ne]
101: 
102: theorem memℓp_gen {f : ∀ i, E i} (hf : Summable fun i => ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal) : Memℓp f p := by
103:   rcases p.trichotomy with (rfl | rfl | hp)
104:   · apply memℓp_zero
105:     have H : Summable fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ) := by simpa using hf
106:     exact (Set.Finite.of_summable_const (by simp) H).subset (Set.subset_univ _)
107:   · apply memℓp_infty
108:     have H : Summable fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ) := by simpa using hf
109:     simpa using ((Set.Finite.of_summable_const (by simp) H).image fun i => ‖f i‖).bddAbove

1: # Lean implementation safeguards
2: 
3: Apply these requirements within the accepted NL0 and the fixed Lean interface.
4: They govern implementation, not additional NL0 detail or a weaker Audit B.
5: Use existing library readers and local checking tools; no separate review
6: model, new premise or mandatory lookup of every familiar declaration is needed.
7: 
8: 1. **Check critical library signatures.** Before relying on a critical or
9:    unfamiliar library application, establish its complete type in the pinned
10:    environment, including explicit, implicit and instance binders and all
11:    side conditions. Read the declaration or check a small typed application
12:    when its signature is uncertain. Do not infer the calling convention from
13:    its name or pass an implicit argument as though it were an explicit one.
14:    A previously checked signature in this context need not be looked up again.
15: 2. **Constrain difficult inference.** When coercions or implicit inference
16:    obscure the intended application, give the intermediate fact an explicit
17:    type and supply the relevant named parameters, such as the set, exponent
18:    or ambient space. Prefer this to leaving Lean to discover those choices by
19:    unfolding large definitions. Routine unambiguous arguments can stay
20:    implicit; explicit parameters must preserve the existing target and inputs.
21: 3. **Check conversions before combining them.** When an argument crosses Lean
22:    representations, first establish a small typed conversion fact, then use
23:    it in the main proof. In particular, distinguish `ℝ`, `ℝ≥0` and `ℝ≥0∞`;
24:    check the conversion direction, nonnegativity and any finiteness conditions.
25:    A conversion is not automatically invertible, and matching notation does
26:    not establish equality of differently typed expressions. Reuse a checked
27:    fact when available. Do not invent another representation, a global helper
28:    requirement or an extra hypothesis just to satisfy this instruction.
29: 4. **Isolate an inference failure.** If compiler feedback identifies a library
30:    application, coercion or expensive inference problem, reduce the next check
31:    to that application or conversion with explicit local types before adding
32:    more proof code. Use `check_auxiliary` in a proof worker, or
33:    `check_lean_types` during preparation when that tool is supplied. Helpers
34:    use only the current allowed inputs and never become new premises. Once
35:    the small check succeeds, integrate the result and recheck the complete
36:    obligation; success of a helper alone does not accept the target.
37: 
38: 5. **Repair after a bounded check.** Native checks have a separate per-call wall
39:    limit, normally 180 seconds, and use the controller-owned 20,000,000 heartbeat budget.
40:    A timeout or heartbeat diagnostic leaves the goal unaccepted and returns
41:    control to the same worker. Inspect the retained candidate and diagnostic,
42:    then check a smaller typed application, conversion or proof fragment before
43:    integrating it. Do not repeat the unchanged expensive candidate or disable
44:    limits to avoid diagnosis. Preserve the target, allowed inputs and proof
45:    requirements; a timeout alone establishes no mathematical gap.
46: 
47: The runtime enforces the per-call wall limit independently of these writing
48: rules. Whole-case and model-stage execution remain unlimited by default.
49: Retain failed attempts and actual diagnostics. Standalone assembly, native
50: trust/signature checks and final machine Audit B remain required.
51: 
52: Before freeze, every complete T declaration must elaborate with exactly its
53: worker parameters, instances and direct inputs. Explicitly supply parameters
54: that their argument types cannot determine; a same-named context variable is
55: not an inference rule. The strict declaration check defines the proposition,
56: without proving it, and rejects unresolved holes and non-proposition goals.
57: `#check` is a useful reader aid, not sufficient declaration acceptance. A proof
58: body cannot resolve a hole in its preceding theorem declaration.
59: 
60: Checked auxiliary propositions receive a `yui_aux_...` name and an explicit
61: application with the existing local parameters/inputs. Reuse these theorems in
62: later auxiliary checks and the final body. The controller retains their actual
63: proof bodies and compiles them into standalone assembly. They are same-node
64: implementation lemmas, not extra assumptions. Read the helper index after a
65: context reset; never rebuild a checked helper merely because a turn ended.
66: 
67: Separate diagnostic printing from proving. `show_term` and similar suggestion
68: output may spend substantial time after the proof tactic runs. If that diagnostic
69: wrapper is implicated, check the same proof without it; only the new successful
70: check establishes acceptance. Do not ignore an unsuccessful process exit. If
71: small helpers pass but a monolithic body exhausts resources, retain the separate
72: checked helper declarations and compose them rather than repeatedly copying
73: their bodies into a growing proof.

import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
noncomputable section
namespace KdV
abbrev Coeff := ℤ → ℂ
abbrev Curve := ℝ → Coeff
def weight (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ := (1 + (k : ℝ)^2) ^ s
def H (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := Summable (fun k => weight s k * ‖f k‖^2)
def hn (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑' k, weight s k * ‖f k‖^2)
def dh (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop :=
  f 0 = 0 ∧ Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k = 0 then 0 else |(k : ℝ)|^(2*s) * ‖f k‖^2)
def dn (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, if k = 0 then 0 else |(k : ℝ)|^(2*s) * ‖f k‖^2)
def realCoeff (f : Coeff) : Prop := ∀ k, f (-k) = star (f k)
def mz (f : Coeff) : Prop := f 0 = 0
def data (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := H s f ∧ mz f
def rd (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := data s f ∧ realCoeff f
def smooth (f : Coeff) : Prop := ∀ m : ℕ, H (m : ℝ) f
def poly (f : Coeff) : Prop := Set.Finite (Function.support f)
def ik (k : ℤ) : ℂ := Complex.I * (k : ℂ)
def air (t : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (k : ℂ)^3) * f k
def proj (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else f k
def mean (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then f 0 else 0
def invD (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else (ik k)⁻¹ * f k
def invD2 (f : Coeff) : Coeff := invD (invD f)
def dx (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => ik k * f k
def mul (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => ∑' a : ℤ, f a * g (k-a)
def cube (f : Coeff) : Coeff := mul (mul f f) f
def low (N : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if |(k : ℝ)| ≤ N then f k else 0
def high (N : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := f - low N f
def eval (f : Coeff) (x : ℝ) : ℂ := ∑' k : ℤ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * f k
def linfty (f : Coeff) : ℝ := sSup ((fun x => ‖eval f x‖) '' Icc 0 (2*Real.pi))
def bn (t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := air (-t) (dx (mul (air t f) (air t g)))
def jn (t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := air (-t) (proj (mul (air t (invD f)) (air t (invD g))))
def cint (a b : ℝ) (f g h : Curve) : Coeff :=
  fun k => ∫ t in a..b, (air (-t) (proj (mul (proj (mul (air t (f t)) (air t (g t)))) (air t (invD (h t)))))) k
def intC (a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Coeff := fun k => ∫ t in a..b, f t k
def stage (n : ℕ) (τ t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n : ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r f g)
def favg (τ α : ℝ) : ℂ := (τ : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (α : ℂ))
def eta (τ α β : ℝ) : ℂ := favg τ (α+β) - favg τ α * favg τ β
def phase1 (a b : ℤ) : ℝ := 3*(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*((a+b):ℤ)
def phase2 (k c p : ℤ) : ℝ := 3*(k:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)*(p:ℝ)
abbrev Mult := ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℂ
def unitMult : Mult := fun _ _ _ _ => 1
def rterm (μ : Mult) (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f g h : Coeff) (k : ℤ) (v : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let a := v.1
  let b := v.2
  let c := k-a-b
  let α := phase1 a b
  let β := phase2 k c (a+b)
  if k = 0 ∨ a+b = 0 then 0 else
    -(τ : ℂ)/(18*ik k) * μ k a b c *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ((n:ℝ)*τ : ℝ) * ((α+β : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      eta τ α β * f a * g b * h c
def rem (μ : Mult) (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f g h : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => ∑' v : ℤ × ℤ, rterm μ n τ f g h k v
def quad (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  (1/6 : ℂ) • proj (mul (air τ (invD f)) (air τ (invD f))) -
  (1/6 : ℂ) • air τ (proj (mul (invD f) (invD f)))
def cubic (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  let F := quad τ f
  let E := fun s => air (τ-s) (invD (cube (air s (invD f))))
  let G := fun s => air (τ-s) (invD2 (mul (air (s-τ) (invD2 F)) (air s (invD f))))
  (1/3 : ℂ) • proj (mul (air τ (invD f)) (invD F)) +
  ((τ/9 : ℝ) : ℂ) • mul (air τ (invD f)) (mean (mul f f)) -
  (1/54 : ℂ) • (E τ - E 0) - ((1/(27*τ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (G τ - G 0)
def step (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := air τ f + quad τ f + cubic τ f
def iter (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : ℕ → Coeff
  | 0 => q
  | n+1 => step τ (iter τ q n)
def pstar : ℝ := 23/14
def aux (γ : ℝ) : ℝ := if γ < 1/2 then 1/2-γ else if γ = 1/2 then 1/8 else 0
def sourceAux (s ε : ℝ) : ℝ := if s = 0 then 1/2+ε else if s < 1/2 then 1/2-s else if s = 1/2 then ε else 0
def beta0 (s ε : ℝ) : ℝ := if s < 1/2 then 2*s-3/2 else if s = 1/2 then -1/2-ε else s-1
def k3 (a b c d : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(b:ℝ)| |(c:ℝ)|))
    (max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(b:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|))
      (max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(c:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|)) (min |(b:ℝ)| (min |(c:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|))))
def contH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, H s (f t)) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
    ∀ r ∈ Icc a b, |r-t| < δ → hn s (f r - f t) < ε
def convH (s : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Coeff) (g : Coeff) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, H s (f n)) ∧ H s g ∧ Tendsto (fun n => hn s (f n-g)) atTop (nhds 0)
def supH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : ℝ := sSup ((fun t => hn s (f t)) '' Icc a b)
def boundedH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, H s (f t)) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, hn s (f t) ≤ C
def aeH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => f t k) (volume.restrict (Icc a b))) ∧
  (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc a b)), H s (f t)) ∧
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc a b)), hn s (f t) ≤ C
def essH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : ℝ :=
  (essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc a b))).toReal
def weakD (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => df t k) volume a b) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ∀ k : ℤ, f t k = f a k + ∫ r in a..t, df r k
def admissible (s a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  aeH s a b f ∧ aeH (-pstar) a b df ∧ weakD a b f df
def xn (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : ℝ := essH 0 a b f + essH (-pstar) a b df
def normDeriv (s a b t : ℝ) (f : Curve) (d : Coeff) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Icc a b,
    0 < |r-t| → |r-t| < δ →
      hn s (f r - f t - ((r-t : ℝ) : ℂ) • d) ≤ ε * |r-t|
def smoothPair (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b f ∧ contH (m:ℝ) a b df ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, normDeriv (m:ℝ) a b t f (df t)
def piecewise (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b f) ∧
  ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ d : ℕ → Curve,
    r 0 = a ∧ r N = b ∧
    (∀ j < N, r j ≤ r (j+1) ∧ smoothPair (r j) (r (j+1)) f (d j) ∧
      (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc (r j) (r (j+1)))), df t = d j t))
def twisted (sign : ℝ) (u : Curve) : Curve := fun t => air (-sign*t) (u t)
def rhs (sign : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => Complex.I * (sign : ℂ) * (k : ℂ)^3 * f k + (1/2 : ℂ) * ik k * mul f f k
def solution (sign s A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  contH s 0 A u ∧ u 0 = q ∧
  (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, realCoeff (u t) ∧ mz (u t)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => rhs sign (u t) k) volume 0 A) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, ∀ k : ℤ, u t k = q k + ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..t, rhs sign (u r) k
def smoothCurve (a b : ℝ) (u : Curve) : Prop := ∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b u
def exact (sign s A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  solution sign s A q u ∧ ∃ us : ℕ → Curve,
    (∀ m : ℕ, solution sign 0 A (low (m:ℝ) q) (us m) ∧ smoothCurve 0 A (us m)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun m => supH 0 0 A (fun t => us m t-u t)) atTop (nhds 0)
end KdV

namespace KdV
def srcScale : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)
def pairing (f g : Coeff) : ℂ := ∑' k : ℤ, f k * star (g k)
def L1dual (s A : ℝ) (g : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => g t k) (volume.restrict (Icc 0 A))) ∧
  (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 A)), dh (-s) (g t)) ∧
  IntegrableOn (fun t => dn (-s) (g t)) (Icc 0 A) volume
def gal (A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (m : ℕ) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  u 0 = low (m:ℝ) q ∧ smoothCurve 0 A u ∧
  (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, rd 0 (u t) ∧ low (m:ℝ) (u t) = u t) ∧
  weakD 0 A u (fun t => low (m:ℝ) (rhs (-1) (u t)))
def galBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Q →
  ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q → hn 0 q ≤ B → dn s q ≤ Q →
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : Curve, gal A q m u → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M
def sourceCompactness : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q →
  ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < s →
  ∃ us : ℕ → Curve, ∃ u : Curve, ∃ κ : ℕ → ℕ,
    (∀ m, gal A q m (us m)) ∧ StrictMono κ ∧ exact (-1) s A q u ∧
    (∃ M : ℝ, (∀ m t, t ∈ Icc 0 A → dn s (us m t) ≤ M) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, 1 < p →
      Tendsto (fun j => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, hn σ (us (κ j) t-u t)^p) atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
    (∀ g : Curve, L1dual s A g →
      Tendsto (fun j => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, pairing (us (κ j) t) (g t)) atTop
        (nhds (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, pairing (u t) (g t))))
def sourceFlow : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q →
    ∃ u : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u ∧
      (∀ v : Curve, solution (-1) s A q v → EqOn u v (Icc 0 A)) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, hn 0 (u t) = hn 0 q) ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q r : Coeff,
      dh s q → dh s r → realCoeff q → realCoeff r → dn s q + dn s r ≤ B →
      ∀ u v : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u → exact (-1) s A r v →
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t-v t) ≤ C*dn s (q-r)) ∧
  (∀ θ B : ℝ, -1 < θ → θ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ B →
    ∃ C D : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < D ∧
      ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q r : Coeff,
        rd 0 q → rd 0 r → hn 0 q+hn 0 r ≤ B →
        ∀ u v : Curve, exact (-1) 0 A q u → exact (-1) 0 A r v →
          ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A,
            dn θ (twisted (-1) u t-twisted (-1) v t) ≤ C*D^A*dn θ (q-r))
def sourceUniform : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Q →
  ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q → hn 0 q ≤ B → dn s q ≤ Q →
    ∀ u : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M
def bit : Prop := galBounds ∧ sourceCompactness ∧ sourceFlow ∧ sourceUniform
def cubicBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ α a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ α → α ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
    ∀ f df : Fin 3 → Curve, (∀ j, admissible α a b (f j) (df j)) →
      H 0 (cint a b (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3,
      K*hn 0 (cint a b (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)) ≤
        C*(b-a)*(∏ j : Fin 3, K*xn a b (f j) (df j)) +
        C*(K*essH (-pstar) a b (f i))*
          (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), K*essH 0 a b (f j))) ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
    ∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, H s (f j)) →
      H 0 (cint a b (fun _ => f 0) (fun _ => f 1) (fun _ => f 2)) ∧
      K*hn 0 (cint a b (fun _ => f 0) (fun _ => f 1) (fun _ => f 2)) ≤
        C*(b-a)^s*(∏ j : Fin 3, K*hn s (f j)))
def productBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 →
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f g : Coeff, H s f → H (sourceAux s ε) g →
    H 0 (mul f g) ∧ K*hn 0 (mul f g) ≤ C*(K*hn s f)*(K*hn (sourceAux s ε) g)
def stageBoundAt (K s ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ β : ℝ, beta0 s ε ≤ β → β ≤ 1+s →
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ t : ℝ, 0 < τ →
  t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) →
  ∀ f g : Coeff, data s f → data s g →
    H β (stage n τ t f g) ∧
    K*hn β (stage n τ t f g) ≤
      C*τ^((1+s-β)/(1+s-beta0 s ε))*(K*hn s f)*(K*hn s g)
def stageBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → s ≠ 1/2 → stageBoundAt K s 0) ∧
  ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 → stageBoundAt K (1/2) ε
def schemeIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ f : Coeff, smooth f → mz f →
    air (-((n:ℝ)*τ)-τ) (step τ (air ((n:ℝ)*τ) f)) =
      f + stage n τ (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) f f +
      intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (fun t => bn t f (stage n τ t f f)) -
      rem unitMult n τ f f f
def fn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => stage n τ t f f
def zn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => f + fn n τ f t
def dz (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t f f
def cn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r f (fn n τ f r))
def qn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (fn n τ f r) (fn n τ f r))
def wn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  qn n τ f (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) + rem unitMult n τ f f f
def vn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => f + fn n τ f t + cn n τ f t + qn n τ f t -
    (((t-(n:ℝ)*τ)/τ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def yn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := vn n τ f - zn n τ f
def dy (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => bn t f (fn n τ f t) + (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (fn n τ f t) (fn n τ f t) -
    ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def drho (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => -bn t (yn n τ f t) (zn n τ f t) -
    (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (yn n τ f t) (yn n τ f t) -
    ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def rho (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => -intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (yn n τ f r) (zn n τ f r)) -
    (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (yn n τ f r) (yn n τ f r)) -
    (((t-(n:ℝ)*τ)/τ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def idx (τ t : ℝ) : ℕ := (Int.floor (t/τ)).toNat
def datum (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (n : ℕ) : Coeff := air (-((n:ℝ)*τ)) (iter τ q n)
def interp (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => vn (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def residual (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t =>
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (idx τ t), rho j τ (datum τ q j) (((j:ℝ)+1)*τ)) +
    rho (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def dres (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => drho (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def dvnum (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t =>
  let n := idx τ t
  let f := datum τ q n
  (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (zn n τ f t) (zn n τ f t) - ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
end KdV

import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
noncomputable section
namespace KdV
abbrev Coeff := ℤ → ℂ
abbrev Curve := ℝ → Coeff
def weight (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ := (1 + (k : ℝ)^2) ^ s
def H (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := Summable (fun k => weight s k * ‖f k‖^2)
def hn (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑' k, weight s k * ‖f k‖^2)
def dh (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop :=
  f 0 = 0 ∧ Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k = 0 then 0 else |(k : ℝ)|^(2*s) * ‖f k‖^2)
def dn (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, if k = 0 then 0 else |(k : ℝ)|^(2*s) * ‖f k‖^2)
def realCoeff (f : Coeff) : Prop := ∀ k, f (-k) = star (f k)
def mz (f : Coeff) : Prop := f 0 = 0
def data (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := H s f ∧ mz f
def rd (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Prop := data s f ∧ realCoeff f
def smooth (f : Coeff) : Prop := ∀ m : ℕ, H (m : ℝ) f
def poly (f : Coeff) : Prop := Set.Finite (Function.support f)
def ik (k : ℤ) : ℂ := Complex.I * (k : ℂ)
def air (t : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (k : ℂ)^3) * f k
def proj (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else f k
def mean (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then f 0 else 0
def invD (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else (ik k)⁻¹ * f k
def invD2 (f : Coeff) : Coeff := invD (invD f)
def dx (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => ik k * f k
def mul (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => ∑' a : ℤ, f a * g (k-a)
def cube (f : Coeff) : Coeff := mul (mul f f) f
def low (N : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := fun k => if |(k : ℝ)| ≤ N then f k else 0
def high (N : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := f - low N f
def eval (f : Coeff) (x : ℝ) : ℂ := ∑' k : ℤ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * f k
def linfty (f : Coeff) : ℝ := sSup ((fun x => ‖eval f x‖) '' Icc 0 (2*Real.pi))
def bn (t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := air (-t) (dx (mul (air t f) (air t g)))
def jn (t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff := air (-t) (proj (mul (air t (invD f)) (air t (invD g))))
def cint (a b : ℝ) (f g h : Curve) : Coeff :=
  fun k => ∫ t in a..b, (air (-t) (proj (mul (proj (mul (air t (f t)) (air t (g t)))) (air t (invD (h t)))))) k
def intC (a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Coeff := fun k => ∫ t in a..b, f t k
def stage (n : ℕ) (τ t : ℝ) (f g : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n : ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r f g)
def favg (τ α : ℝ) : ℂ := (τ : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (α : ℂ))
def eta (τ α β : ℝ) : ℂ := favg τ (α+β) - favg τ α * favg τ β
def phase1 (a b : ℤ) : ℝ := 3*(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)*((a+b):ℤ)
def phase2 (k c p : ℤ) : ℝ := 3*(k:ℝ)*(c:ℝ)*(p:ℝ)
abbrev Mult := ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℂ
def unitMult : Mult := fun _ _ _ _ => 1
def rterm (μ : Mult) (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f g h : Coeff) (k : ℤ) (v : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let a := v.1
  let b := v.2
  let c := k-a-b
  let α := phase1 a b
  let β := phase2 k c (a+b)
  if k = 0 ∨ a+b = 0 then 0 else
    -(τ : ℂ)/(18*ik k) * μ k a b c *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ((n:ℝ)*τ : ℝ) * ((α+β : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      eta τ α β * f a * g b * h c
def rem (μ : Mult) (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f g h : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => ∑' v : ℤ × ℤ, rterm μ n τ f g h k v
def quad (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  (1/6 : ℂ) • proj (mul (air τ (invD f)) (air τ (invD f))) -
  (1/6 : ℂ) • air τ (proj (mul (invD f) (invD f)))
def cubic (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  let F := quad τ f
  let E := fun s => air (τ-s) (invD (cube (air s (invD f))))
  let G := fun s => air (τ-s) (invD2 (mul (air (s-τ) (invD2 F)) (air s (invD f))))
  (1/3 : ℂ) • proj (mul (air τ (invD f)) (invD F)) +
  ((τ/9 : ℝ) : ℂ) • mul (air τ (invD f)) (mean (mul f f)) -
  (1/54 : ℂ) • (E τ - E 0) - ((1/(27*τ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (G τ - G 0)
def step (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff := air τ f + quad τ f + cubic τ f
def iter (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : ℕ → Coeff
  | 0 => q
  | n+1 => step τ (iter τ q n)
def pstar : ℝ := 23/14
def aux (γ : ℝ) : ℝ := if γ < 1/2 then 1/2-γ else if γ = 1/2 then 1/8 else 0
def sourceAux (s ε : ℝ) : ℝ := if s = 0 then 1/2+ε else if s < 1/2 then 1/2-s else if s = 1/2 then ε else 0
def beta0 (s ε : ℝ) : ℝ := if s < 1/2 then 2*s-3/2 else if s = 1/2 then -1/2-ε else s-1
def k3 (a b c d : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(b:ℝ)| |(c:ℝ)|))
    (max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(b:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|))
      (max (min |(a:ℝ)| (min |(c:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|)) (min |(b:ℝ)| (min |(c:ℝ)| |(d:ℝ)|))))
def contH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, H s (f t)) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
    ∀ r ∈ Icc a b, |r-t| < δ → hn s (f r - f t) < ε
def convH (s : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Coeff) (g : Coeff) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, H s (f n)) ∧ H s g ∧ Tendsto (fun n => hn s (f n-g)) atTop (nhds 0)
def supH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : ℝ := sSup ((fun t => hn s (f t)) '' Icc a b)
def boundedH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, H s (f t)) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, hn s (f t) ≤ C
def aeH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => f t k) (volume.restrict (Icc a b))) ∧
  (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc a b)), H s (f t)) ∧
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc a b)), hn s (f t) ≤ C
def essH (s a b : ℝ) (f : Curve) : ℝ :=
  (essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc a b))).toReal
def weakD (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => df t k) volume a b) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ∀ k : ℤ, f t k = f a k + ∫ r in a..t, df r k
def admissible (s a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  aeH s a b f ∧ aeH (-pstar) a b df ∧ weakD a b f df
def xn (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : ℝ := essH 0 a b f + essH (-pstar) a b df
def normDeriv (s a b t : ℝ) (f : Curve) (d : Coeff) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Icc a b,
    0 < |r-t| → |r-t| < δ →
      hn s (f r - f t - ((r-t : ℝ) : ℂ) • d) ≤ ε * |r-t|
def smoothPair (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b f ∧ contH (m:ℝ) a b df ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, normDeriv (m:ℝ) a b t f (df t)
def piecewise (a b : ℝ) (f df : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b f) ∧
  ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ d : ℕ → Curve,
    r 0 = a ∧ r N = b ∧
    (∀ j < N, r j ≤ r (j+1) ∧ smoothPair (r j) (r (j+1)) f (d j) ∧
      (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc (r j) (r (j+1)))), df t = d j t))
def twisted (sign : ℝ) (u : Curve) : Curve := fun t => air (-sign*t) (u t)
def rhs (sign : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  fun k => Complex.I * (sign : ℂ) * (k : ℂ)^3 * f k + (1/2 : ℂ) * ik k * mul f f k
def solution (sign s A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  contH s 0 A u ∧ u 0 = q ∧
  (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, realCoeff (u t) ∧ mz (u t)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => rhs sign (u t) k) volume 0 A) ∧
  ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, ∀ k : ℤ, u t k = q k + ∫ r in (0:ℝ)..t, rhs sign (u r) k
def smoothCurve (a b : ℝ) (u : Curve) : Prop := ∀ m : ℕ, contH (m:ℝ) a b u
def exact (sign s A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  solution sign s A q u ∧ ∃ us : ℕ → Curve,
    (∀ m : ℕ, solution sign 0 A (low (m:ℝ) q) (us m) ∧ smoothCurve 0 A (us m)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun m => supH 0 0 A (fun t => us m t-u t)) atTop (nhds 0)
end KdV

namespace KdV
def srcScale : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)
def pairing (f g : Coeff) : ℂ := ∑' k : ℤ, f k * star (g k)
def L1dual (s A : ℝ) (g : Curve) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => g t k) (volume.restrict (Icc 0 A))) ∧
  (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 A)), dh (-s) (g t)) ∧
  IntegrableOn (fun t => dn (-s) (g t)) (Icc 0 A) volume
def gal (A : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (m : ℕ) (u : Curve) : Prop :=
  u 0 = low (m:ℝ) q ∧ smoothCurve 0 A u ∧
  (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, rd 0 (u t) ∧ low (m:ℝ) (u t) = u t) ∧
  weakD 0 A u (fun t => low (m:ℝ) (rhs (-1) (u t)))
def galBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Q →
  ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q → hn 0 q ≤ B → dn s q ≤ Q →
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : Curve, gal A q m u → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M
def sourceCompactness : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q →
  ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < s →
  ∃ us : ℕ → Curve, ∃ u : Curve, ∃ κ : ℕ → ℕ,
    (∀ m, gal A q m (us m)) ∧ StrictMono κ ∧ exact (-1) s A q u ∧
    (∃ M : ℝ, (∀ m t, t ∈ Icc 0 A → dn s (us m t) ≤ M) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, 1 < p →
      Tendsto (fun j => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, hn σ (us (κ j) t-u t)^p) atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
    (∀ g : Curve, L1dual s A g →
      Tendsto (fun j => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, pairing (us (κ j) t) (g t)) atTop
        (nhds (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..A, pairing (u t) (g t))))
def sourceFlow : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q →
    ∃ u : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u ∧
      (∀ v : Curve, solution (-1) s A q v → EqOn u v (Icc 0 A)) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, hn 0 (u t) = hn 0 q) ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q r : Coeff,
      dh s q → dh s r → realCoeff q → realCoeff r → dn s q + dn s r ≤ B →
      ∀ u v : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u → exact (-1) s A r v →
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t-v t) ≤ C*dn s (q-r)) ∧
  (∀ θ B : ℝ, -1 < θ → θ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ B →
    ∃ C D : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < D ∧
      ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ q r : Coeff,
        rd 0 q → rd 0 r → hn 0 q+hn 0 r ≤ B →
        ∀ u v : Curve, exact (-1) 0 A q u → exact (-1) 0 A r v →
          ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A,
            dn θ (twisted (-1) u t-twisted (-1) v t) ≤ C*D^A*dn θ (q-r))
def sourceUniform : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∀ B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Q →
  ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ q : Coeff, dh s q → realCoeff q → hn 0 q ≤ B → dn s q ≤ Q →
    ∀ u : Curve, exact (-1) s A q u → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 A, dn s (u t) ≤ M
def bit : Prop := galBounds ∧ sourceCompactness ∧ sourceFlow ∧ sourceUniform
def cubicBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ α a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ α → α ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
    ∀ f df : Fin 3 → Curve, (∀ j, admissible α a b (f j) (df j)) →
      H 0 (cint a b (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3,
      K*hn 0 (cint a b (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)) ≤
        C*(b-a)*(∏ j : Fin 3, K*xn a b (f j) (df j)) +
        C*(K*essH (-pstar) a b (f i))*
          (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), K*essH 0 a b (f j))) ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
    ∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, H s (f j)) →
      H 0 (cint a b (fun _ => f 0) (fun _ => f 1) (fun _ => f 2)) ∧
      K*hn 0 (cint a b (fun _ => f 0) (fun _ => f 1) (fun _ => f 2)) ≤
        C*(b-a)^s*(∏ j : Fin 3, K*hn s (f j)))
def productBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 →
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f g : Coeff, H s f → H (sourceAux s ε) g →
    H 0 (mul f g) ∧ K*hn 0 (mul f g) ≤ C*(K*hn s f)*(K*hn (sourceAux s ε) g)
def stageBoundAt (K s ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ β : ℝ, beta0 s ε ≤ β → β ≤ 1+s →
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ t : ℝ, 0 < τ →
  t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) →
  ∀ f g : Coeff, data s f → data s g →
    H β (stage n τ t f g) ∧
    K*hn β (stage n τ t f g) ≤
      C*τ^((1+s-β)/(1+s-beta0 s ε))*(K*hn s f)*(K*hn s g)
def stageBounds (K : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → s ≠ 1/2 → stageBoundAt K s 0) ∧
  ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 → stageBoundAt K (1/2) ε
def schemeIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ f : Coeff, smooth f → mz f →
    air (-((n:ℝ)*τ)-τ) (step τ (air ((n:ℝ)*τ) f)) =
      f + stage n τ (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) f f +
      intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (fun t => bn t f (stage n τ t f f)) -
      rem unitMult n τ f f f
def fn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => stage n τ t f f
def zn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => f + fn n τ f t
def dz (f : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t f f
def cn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r f (fn n τ f r))
def qn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (fn n τ f r) (fn n τ f r))
def wn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Coeff :=
  qn n τ f (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) + rem unitMult n τ f f f
def vn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => f + fn n τ f t + cn n τ f t + qn n τ f t -
    (((t-(n:ℝ)*τ)/τ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def yn (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve := vn n τ f - zn n τ f
def dy (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => bn t f (fn n τ f t) + (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (fn n τ f t) (fn n τ f t) -
    ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def drho (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => -bn t (yn n τ f t) (zn n τ f t) -
    (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (yn n τ f t) (yn n τ f t) -
    ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def rho (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (f : Coeff) : Curve :=
  fun t => -intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (yn n τ f r) (zn n τ f r)) -
    (1/2 : ℂ) • intC ((n:ℝ)*τ) t (fun r => bn r (yn n τ f r) (yn n τ f r)) -
    (((t-(n:ℝ)*τ)/τ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
def idx (τ t : ℝ) : ℕ := (Int.floor (t/τ)).toNat
def datum (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) (n : ℕ) : Coeff := air (-((n:ℝ)*τ)) (iter τ q n)
def interp (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => vn (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def residual (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t =>
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (idx τ t), rho j τ (datum τ q j) (((j:ℝ)+1)*τ)) +
    rho (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def dres (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t => drho (idx τ t) τ (datum τ q (idx τ t)) t
def dvnum (τ : ℝ) (q : Coeff) : Curve := fun t =>
  let n := idx τ t
  let f := datum τ q n
  (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (zn n τ f t) (zn n τ f t) - ((τ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • wn n τ f
end KdV

namespace KdV
def phaseEst : Prop :=
  ∀ τ α β : ℝ, 0 < τ →
    ((α = 0 ∨ β = 0) → eta τ α β = 0) ∧
    (α ≠ 0 → β ≠ 0 →
      ‖eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2*min |α/β| |β/α| ∧
      ‖eta τ α β‖ ≤ τ*min |α| |β|)
def freqEst : Prop :=
  ∀ a b c d : ℤ, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 → a+b+c+d = 0 →
  ∀ N1 N2 N3 N4 : ℝ,
    List.Perm [|(a:ℝ)|, |(b:ℝ)|, |(c:ℝ)|, |(d:ℝ)|] [N1,N2,N3,N4] →
    N4 ≤ N3 → N3 ≤ N2 → N2 ≤ N1 →
    N1 ≤ 3*N2 ∧
    |(d:ℝ)|⁻¹ * min (|(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)|/|(c:ℝ)*(d:ℝ)|)
      (|(c:ℝ)*(d:ℝ)|/|(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)|) ≤ 3/N3 ∧
    |((a+b:ℤ):ℝ)| / max |(a:ℝ)*(b:ℝ)| |(c:ℝ)*(d:ℝ)| ≤ 6/N3
def phaseAndGeometry : Prop := phaseEst ∧ freqEst
def quadTerm (x : Fin 4 → ℤ → ℝ) (Ω : Set (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)) (v : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) : ℝ :=
  let a := v.1
  let b := v.2.1
  let c := v.2.2
  let d := -(a+b+c)
  if v ∈ Ω ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ c ≠ 0 ∧ d ≠ 0 then
    x 0 a * x 1 b * x 2 c * x 3 d / k3 a b c d else 0
def fourLinear : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : Fin 4 → ℤ → ℝ,
    (∀ j, x j 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ k, 0 ≤ x j k) ∧ Summable (fun k => (x j k)^2)) →
    ∀ Ω : Set (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
      Summable (quadTerm x Ω) ∧
      (∑' v, quadTerm x Ω v) ≤ C*(∏ j : Fin 4, Real.sqrt (∑' k, (x j k)^2))
def triOn (s : ℝ) (G : (Fin 3 → Coeff) → Coeff) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, data s (f j)) → ∀ i : Fin 3,
    (∀ u v : Coeff, data s u → data s v →
      G (Function.update f i (u+v)) = G (Function.update f i u) + G (Function.update f i v)) ∧
    (∀ u : Coeff, data s u → ∀ c : ℂ,
      G (Function.update f i (c • u)) = c • G (Function.update f i u))
def triBound (s τ C : ℝ) (G : (Fin 3 → Coeff) → Coeff) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, data s (f j)) →
    H 0 (G f) ∧ hn 0 (G f) ≤ C*τ^(1+s)*(∏ j : Fin 3, hn s (f j))
def remainderCore : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
  ∀ μ : Mult, (∀ k a b c, ‖μ k a b c‖ ≤ 1) →
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
    let G := fun f : Fin 3 → Coeff => rem μ n τ (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)
    triOn s G ∧ triBound s τ C G ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, data s (f j)) →
      ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (rterm μ n τ (f 0) (f 1) (f 2) k)) ∧
    (∀ F : (Fin 3 → Coeff) → Coeff, triOn s F →
      (∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ triBound s τ D F) →
      (∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, data s (f j) ∧ poly (f j)) → F f = G f) →
      ∀ f : Fin 3 → Coeff, (∀ j, data s (f j)) → F f = G f)
def numericalRemainder (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
  ∀ f w : Coeff, data 0 f → data γ w → hn γ w ≤ M → hn 0 (f-w) ≤ 1 →
    H 0 (rem unitMult n τ f f f) ∧
    hn 0 (rem unitMult n τ f f f) ≤ C*τ*(τ^γ+hn 0 (f-w))
def remainderBounds (γ : ℝ) : Prop := remainderCore ∧ numericalRemainder γ
def linearBounds : Prop :=
  (∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ f : Coeff, H s f → H s (air t f) ∧ hn s (air t f) = hn s f) ∧
  (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f : Coeff, (realCoeff f → realCoeff (air t f)) ∧ (mz f → mz (air t f))) ∧
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    (∀ f : Coeff, data 0 f → H 1 (invD f) ∧ hn 1 (invD f)+linfty (invD f) ≤ C*hn 0 f) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : Coeff, data 0 f → data 0 g →
      H (-pstar) (bn t f g) ∧ hn (-pstar) (bn t f g) ≤ C*hn 0 f*hn 0 g ∧
      H 1 (jn t f g) ∧ hn 1 (jn t f g) ≤ C*hn 0 f*hn 0 g) ∧
    (∀ f : Coeff, H 1 f → linfty f ≤ C*hn 1 f) ∧
    (∀ f g : Coeff, H 1 f → H 1 g →
      H 1 (mul f g) ∧ hn 1 (mul f g) ≤ C*hn 1 f*hn 1 g) ∧
    (∀ f g : Coeff, H 0 f → H 0 g →
      H 0 (invD (proj (mul f g))) ∧ hn 0 (invD (proj (mul f g))) ≤ C*hn 0 f*hn 0 g) ∧
    (∀ f : Coeff, mz f → H 0 (invD f) →
      H (-pstar) f ∧ hn (-pstar) f ≤ hn 0 (invD f)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : Coeff, mz f → H 0 (invD f) → H 0 g →
      H 0 (jn t f g) ∧ hn 0 (jn t f g) ≤ C*hn 0 (invD f)*hn 0 g)
def normalForms : Prop :=
  (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : Coeff, data 0 f → data 0 g → jn t f g = jn t g f) ∧
  (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → ∀ f df g dg : Curve,
    piecewise a b f df → piecewise a b g dg →
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, mz (f t) ∧ mz (g t)) →
    intC a b (fun t => bn t (f t) (g t)) =
      (1/3 : ℂ) • (jn b (f b) (g b)-jn a (f a) (g a)) -
      (1/3 : ℂ) • intC a b (fun t => jn t (df t) (g t)+jn t (f t) (dg t))) ∧
  (∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → ∀ f g h : Curve,
    smoothCurve a b f → smoothCurve a b g → smoothCurve a b h →
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, mz (f t) ∧ mz (g t) ∧ mz (h t)) →
    intC a b (fun t => jn t (bn t (f t) (g t)) (h t)) = cint a b f g h) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ t : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ f : Coeff, data 0 f →
    stage n τ t f f = (1/6 : ℂ) • (jn t f f - jn ((n:ℝ)*τ) f f))
def basic : Prop := linearBounds ∧ normalForms
def normalizedProduct (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f g : Coeff, H γ f → H (aux γ) g →
    H 0 (mul f g) ∧ hn 0 (mul f g) ≤ C*hn γ f*hn (aux γ) g
def normalizedStages (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
  ∀ w : Coeff, data γ w → hn γ w ≤ M → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ τ t : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 →
  t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) →
    H (aux γ) (stage n τ t w w) ∧ hn (aux γ) (stage n τ t w w) ≤ C*τ^γ ∧
    H (1+γ) (stage n τ t w w) ∧ hn (1+γ) (stage n τ t w w) ≤ C
def continuousBounds (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ aux γ ∧ aux γ < 1 ∧ cubicBounds 1 ∧ normalizedProduct γ ∧ normalizedStages γ
def flow (T γ R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ q : Coeff, rd γ q → hn γ q ≤ R →
    (∃ u : Curve, exact 1 γ T q u) ∧
    (∀ u : Curve, exact 1 γ T q u →
      (∀ v : Curve, solution 1 γ T q v → EqOn u v (Icc 0 T)) ∧
      (smooth q → smoothCurve 0 T u) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, hn γ (u t) ≤ A) ∧
      supH γ 0 T (twisted 1 u) ≤ A ∧
      (∀ s t : ℝ, t ∈ Icc 0 T → H s (u t) →
        H s (twisted 1 u t) ∧ hn s (twisted 1 u t) = hn s (u t)) ∧
      (smooth q → weakD 0 T (twisted 1 u)
        (fun t => (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (twisted 1 u t) (twisted 1 u t))))) ∧
  (∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q r : Coeff,
    rd 0 q → rd 0 r → hn 0 q+hn 0 r ≤ B →
    ∀ u v : Curve, exact 1 0 T q u → exact 1 0 T r v →
      supH 0 0 T (u-v) ≤ C*hn 0 (q-r))
def interpolation : Prop :=
  ∀ q : Coeff, smooth q → realCoeff q → mz q → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
    (∀ n : ℕ, smooth (iter τ q n) ∧ realCoeff (iter τ q n) ∧ mz (iter τ q n)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, interp τ q ((n:ℝ)*τ) = datum τ q n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, yn n τ (datum τ q n) ((n:ℝ)*τ) = 0) ∧
    (∀ L : ℕ, piecewise 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ q) (dvnum τ q) ∧
      weakD 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ q) (dvnum τ q) ∧
      weakD 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (residual τ q) (dres τ q)) ∧
    residual τ q 0 = 0 ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      dvnum τ q t = (1/2 : ℂ) • bn t (interp τ q t) (interp τ q t) + dres τ q t) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
      residual τ q t-residual τ q ((n:ℝ)*τ) = rho n τ (datum τ q n) t)
end KdV
